description: The newsletter's subscriber counts, as totals only: no email address and no single subscriber's row. Returns subscribers (active = confirmed and still subscribed, pending = waiting on the confirmation link, unsubscribed), agent_inboxes (active and pending readers whose address is at an inbox built for agents: agentmail.to), active_by_source (the signup form: subscribe, footer, bookmarks, home, collection, archive, agent, mcp, unknown), and over the last `days` (default 28, at most 365, UTC, today included): confirmed.total, confirmed.daily (one row a day), confirmed.by_landing_path (the page the form was on, top 50), confirmed.by_utm_source (the utm_source of the link that brought the reader, read from the first page of their visit, else from the page the form was on), confirmed.by_referrer (the site that linked to the first page of the visit), confirmed.by_channel (one per reader: an agent's signup as “agent (MCP)” or “agent (form)”, else the campaign tag, else the referring site), confirmed.by_origin (one per reader in plain words: LinkedIn, X, Google, AI assistant, Other search, Agent, Newsletter or feed, Direct, Other, Not recorded; Direct is a visit with no campaign tag or referring site, Not recorded a signup from before visits were recorded), confirmed.by_source (the signup form or door), confirmed.heard_from (the answers to “How did you hear about us?”, given after confirming, counted by answer), audience (every active reader's two picks after confirming: answered, active, by_role and by_industry, counted by the page's choices), engagement (the issues delivered in the window as Resend counts them: issues, delivered, opened, clicked, open_rate and click_rate in percent of delivered, readers who opened or clicked at all, clicked_by_role, and by_issue with each issue's numbers and its most clicked link; clicks are the number to trust, since Apple Mail opens what it fetches, and everything reads zero while tracking is off in Resend), unsubscribes, and blocked_signups (signups the form's browser check refused, total and by day, no address kept). (none) counts rows with no value; (other) counts values that are no page address or campaign token. Curator only.

days.description: The window in days, today included (UTC).
